findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever — no test script, no vitest/@builder.io/qwik/testing in devDependencies, despite Qwik's documented `qwik add vitest` workflow being a one-liner.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest via `npm run qwik add vitest`; the pure functions in src/lib and the MoveTables comparator need no DOM and are the cheapest, highest-value starts.

findings.issue: Search/type/generation filtering, page clamping and 48-per-page slicing are client-side logic with no coverage; bugs like matching raw API names instead of humanized ones, or an unclamped page on empty results, would ship silently.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/paginate computation into a pure function and unit-test it: empty filters → 1025, humanized-name matching, page clamp at totalPages, last-page slicing.

findings.issue: The sort comparator encodes 'missing values sort last in both directions' via an early return before the direction factor; the default level-then-name ordering is also custom. Both are silent-breakage magnets.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test compareRows and the default-order branch directly with rows containing null power/accuracy and null level.

findings.issue: latestFlavor returns null when the last English entry has empty flavor_text even if earlier English entries have text — a plausible latent bug with no test to expose it.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests with \n/\f whitespace runs, non-English entries last, and the empty-last-entry edge case; fix the function to skip empty entries.

findings.issue: The alternate-form exclusion rule (id > 10000, known species) is duplicated in three places; weakening one copy re-admits Mega Evolutions to a single list.
findings.suggestion: Centralize into one isDefaultForm(id) helper and test it; then test that a card list never contains an id > 10000.

findings.issue: fetchJson caches 404 as null forever and evicts cache entries on rejection; a refactor that caches rejected promises turns one transient API error into a permanently broken page.
findings.suggestion: Test cache semantics: 404 → null and cached; rejection → entry removed and retried on next call.

findings.issue: The method-ordering comparator (LEVEL_UP/MACHINE/EGG/TUTOR then alphabetical) uses an asymmetric branch with a 999 sentinel — subtle and untested.
findings.suggestion: Feed tables named level-up/machine/egg/tutor/light-screen/zen-headbutt through the sort and assert the spec order.

findings.issue: Lowest-level-learned merge per move/method is untested; an inverted comparison changes every level-up table on the site.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the merge with a move learned at levels 37 and 1 in the same version group, and with null levels.

findings.issue: buildHomeUrl's omit-defaults rule and the popstate re-sync listener are the app's URL-state contract with the acceptance tests; regressions (leaked ?page=1, back-button desync) would only surface as end-to-end failures.
findings.suggestion: Test buildHomeUrl for defaults and combined filters; component-test the popstate sync with @builder.io/qwik/testing's createDOM if practical.

findings.issue: Recursion over evolves_to has no depth guard and no tests for branching chains (Eevee) or missing species nodes.
findings.suggestion: Test evolutionTree with a branching chain fixture and assert the nested structure.

summary: The app shipped with zero tests and no test infrastructure, even though Qwik's current recommended Vitest setup is a one-liner and the highest-risk code (filtering, pagination, table sorting, flavor-text extraction, caching) is pure, easily testable logic. Several spots — latestFlavor's empty-last-entry behavior, the duplicated alternate-form exclusion, and the move-method comparator — are exactly the kind of subtle code that hides latent bugs and breaks under refactor. The first PR into this codebase should add vitest and cover the five pure-logic seams called out above.
